29-584.name: Ramanagara
29-584.tagline: Silk City of Karnataka — Asia's largest cocoon market, Bidadi auto cluster, and the Sholay badlands

strengths.title: Asia's Largest Silk Cocoon Market
strengths.detail: Ramanagara is India's biggest cocoon trading hub — the market town anchoring Karnataka's 80%+ share of national raw silk production

strengths.title: Bidadi Industrial Area — Toyota & Coca-Cola
strengths.detail: KIADB flagship estate hosting Toyota Kirloskar Motor's plants and Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages, plus a 1,400 MW gas-based power plant

strengths.title: Bengaluru-Mysuru Expressway Corridor
strengths.detail: ~50 km from Bengaluru on the 10-lane expressway — prime location for satellite investment and logistics

strengths.title: Closepet Granite Belt
strengths.detail: Major building-grade granite reserves; a long-standing quarrying and stone-processing economy

strengths.title: Savandurga — One of Asia's Largest Monoliths
strengths.detail: Ramadevara Betta and Savandurga hills: vulture sanctuary, trekking and film-shooting backdrops (Sholay was filmed here)

strengths.title: Mekedatu & Sangam River Tourism
strengths.detail: Cauvery-Arkavathi confluence at Sangam and the Mekedatu gorge — high-footfall weekend destinations from Bengaluru

strengths.title: Sericulture Ecosystem Depth
strengths.detail: Chawki rearing centres, grainages and reelers across the district; Sericulture College at Channapatna taluk belt

strengths.title: Janapada Loka Folk-Arts Museum
strengths.detail: State folk-culture museum on the Bengaluru-Mysuru highway, reinforcing a cultural-tourism anchor

challenges.title: Per Capita Income Below State Average

challenges.title: Quarrying & Environmental Externalities
challenges.detail: Granite quarrying dust, blasting and hill degradation around Ramadevara Betta and Savandurga

challenges.title: Urbanisation Without Matching Civic Infrastructure
challenges.detail: Expressway-driven growth outruns water, sewerage and town-planning capacity

challenges.title: Silk Price Volatility

challenges.title: Expressway Corridor Congestion
